items.line: Up to 25,000 North Korean citizens may be working in Russia’s military drone industry, an 11-country sanctions-monitoring group reports.
items.page_title: Up to 25,000 North Koreans may be making military drones in Russia. Sanctions monitors say they enter on student visas. — Meduza
